subject.title: improve(ios): guide first-run users into gateway onboarding

question: Should the iOS preview-tour first-run experience be rebased and adopted on top of current main, narrowed to a smaller preview-only follow-up, or paused in favor of current main's onboarding direction?
rationale: The remaining decision is not only mechanical: this PR adds a new preview/sample onboarding mode while current main has since landed overlapping onboarding, routing, security-copy, and typography decisions.

options.title: Rebase and adopt preview tour
options.body: Keep the feature direction, but require conflict resolution, branded typography, preserved configured-Gateway routing, and fresh simulator proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to preview-only follow-up
options.body: Extract only the sample preview pieces maintainers still want and leave setup-code or connection-path work to focused current-main PRs.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Treat current main's merged onboarding refresh as the maintained direction if the preview tour is no longer desired.

recommendation.title: Rebase and adopt preview tour
recommendation.body: Keep the feature direction, but require conflict resolution, branded typography, preserved configured-Gateway routing, and fresh simulator proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the clearest current-main ownership signal on the routing and onboarding decision surface that the branch conflicts with.
